title: Source-owner metadata probe (--version) inherits the whole remaining evaluation deadline and can starve the mandatory closing tail
outcome: Source-owner metadata probe (--version) inherits the whole remaining evaluation deadline and can starve the mandatory closing tail
acceptance: The source-owner metadata probe (--version, run by engram_source_owner_observe_with before the source schema probe) has an explicit, finite, separately funded window of at least 60 s with the 10 s non-aborting warning. A slow probe can no longer consume the time funded for the mandatory evaluation tail (closing, policy and evidence reads). A behavioural test with a scripted slow probe shows the evaluation's mandatory tail still completes.

No effective limit becomes shorter than it is today without Greg's recorded word. If the chosen window is shorter than the window the probe can reach today (the remaining request deadline, up to the previous 780 s request maximum), Greg's decision is recorded on this item, verbatim with its source, before the change lands.
